region_scene_page.compact: New wave carried some punk economy into the 1980s but made room for synthesizers, reggae/dance rhythm, fashion, and pop hooks.
region_scene_page.standard: New wave carried some punk economy into the 1980s but made room for synthesizers, reggae/dance rhythm, fashion, and pop hooks.
